authorship: AI-authored analytical review; not human verified.
scope: Sections 3–7: 19 bounded canonical technical-transparency and harm-reduction propositions; all 18 prior records reviewed, four corrected, one duplicate retired, two missing lifecycle propositions added.
excluded_material: Bibliography, examples, case studies, descriptive method inventories and research-opportunity lists as independently mandatory controls.

Section 6 collection/filtering and model-building applications repeat represented practices; optional broader impact examination and TEVV-result sharing are illustrative lifecycle context, not additional mandatory controls.
Appendices provide references and explanatory metrics/methods; they are not a normative conformance corpus.

entries.source_comparison: No technique is comprehensive; provenance tracking and detection must be applied with social efforts. The record expresses complementary measures, not a mandatory fixed technical stack.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: C2PA harms modelling, metadata leakage, signing vulnerabilities and scaling/retention trade-offs are informative considerations. Assessing them is analytical recommended practice, not a conformance obligation.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Red-teaming/testing can assess capability to generate AIG-CSAM/NCII but cannot itself change model behaviour; known-prompt, resource and legal limitations remain material.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.

entries.source_comparison: Section 4.1.1 states one evaluation package: detection accuracy, robustness/security against benign modifications and attacks, and distortion/content quality. Duplicate EXTREQ-5205096A50B3E6B6 was retired with historical provenance; this broader existing identity is retained.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.

entries.source_comparison: Watermark selection involves modality, quality/capacity trade-offs, attacks, scalability and privacy. The source does not prescribe one watermark or mandate watermarking.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Evaluation datasets should reflect intended distributions, benign/adversarial transformations and unseen generators; false-positive harm and thresholds matter. Source text is informative evaluation guidance.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.

entries.source_comparison: Metadata recording needs effectiveness evaluation beyond harms modelling; detecting present metadata is straightforward, while validation/interpretation is the key question. The cited sections do not specify interoperability/persistence tests as a conformance requirement.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.
entries.current_summary: Evaluate metadata-recording schemes for their intended benefits as well as potential harms, and distinguish detecting metadata from validating or interpreting it.

entries.source_comparison: Context, reproducibility, adversarial testing and benchmarking limitations qualify reported performance. Base-rate interpretation draws on detection metrics context; no required reporting format is prescribed.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.

entries.source_comparison: Metadata could record creation/edit history; ecosystem adoption is challenging. Signed metadata attests to a signer claim and cannot establish factual accuracy.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Human-facing labels can communicate provenance, but design effectiveness is uncertain and context/modality dependent. No universal label duty or guaranteed comprehension is established.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.
entries.current_summary: Design labels and disclosures so intended users can notice and understand synthetic or manipulated content status.

entries.source_comparison: Output filtering can block harmful images; hashes support confirmation/reporting and takedown. False results, scalability and privacy leakage constrain these potential mitigations.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Training-data and input filtering are potential mitigations with legal constraints, imperfect labels/classifiers and compositional generation limitations. No complete prevention guarantee is implied.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Human-assisted detection evaluation depends on the assistance form: model performance for training-data assistance, human accuracy/time/difficulty for final-decision assistance. Automation/confirmation effects are broader human-factors context, not prescribed metrics here.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.
entries.current_summary: Evaluate human-assisted synthetic-content detection using measures appropriate to the form of human assistance.

entries.source_comparison: More sociotechnical research across demographics, systems and environments is recommended. Labels affect trust and judgment; no fixed accessibility/comprehension/persistence test suite is prescribed.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.
entries.current_summary: Research and evaluate how people interact with digital-content transparency information across demographics, technical systems and environments to inform label design.

entries.source_comparison: Image, video, audio and text detection have different methods and generalisation limitations; cross-modal performance must not be presumed.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Digital signatures provide tamper evidence and attribution; they cannot verify metadata accuracy. Certificate trust and signed-data validation remain separate from factual truth.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Supports evaluation/assurance evidence as a constituent property.

entries.source_comparison: Detector outputs are uncertain and vulnerable to generalisation, editing and attacks. The record is analytical recommended practice about operating limitations, not a normative detection protocol.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Provides technical or harm-reduction context without directly establishing an operational invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Section 6, printed page 41: effectiveness of these techniques should be verified before deployment.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Predeployment effectiveness verification supports assurance; it does not independently establish a whole invariant.

entries.source_comparison: Section 6, printed page 42: transparency efforts are enhanced by establishing mechanisms for diverse user feedback, especially false positives and false negatives. This is analytical recommended practice, not a mandatory report format.
entries.reverse_coverage_rationale: Diverse user feedback informs monitoring and reassessment without independently establishing a whole invariant.

unresolved_issues: The source is an informative technical overview. Analytical recommendations must not be presented as normative technical conformance or legal duties.
AI-authored review is not human verification.
schema_representation_limits: An informative technical overview is represented as recommended practice; this must remain distinguishable from a normative protocol or legal duty.
